result.title: ShowNow: Fine-Grained Speculative Streaming for Responsive World Models
result.comment: 23 pages, including appendix. Video examples provided as ancillary files
result.summary: Interactive world models must generate video continuously while responding promptly to user actions. Real-time throughput alone leaves input latency unresolved: coarse generation blocks delay action updates, and generation after input adds work to the response path. We introduce ShowNow, a fine-grained speculative streaming framework that uses computation available during playback to prepare action-conditioned futures before input arrives. Single-latent commitment enables frequent decisions, while configurable preparation covers one to eight actions. We construct a matched multi-future dataset to train alternative continuations from a common state; shared-history tree execution and fused commitment make their preparation efficient. On a single H100, our 5B model sustains 480p generation at 16 fps with eight prepared futures. In ViZDoom, the complete ShowNow deployment reduces median input-to-display latency from 620 to 208 ms relative to the native-block SolarWM-FT deployment. Matched-policy experiments reduce restart empty ticks from 1.56% to 0.09% (94%) and improve on-time responses to action changes. These results establish complementary roles for fine-grained commitment and advance preparation, with measured trade-offs in visual fidelity and long-horizon consistency. ShowNow turns playback-time computation into responsive visual interaction. Project: https://github.com/showlab/ShowNow.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ShowNow：利用视频播放期间的空闲算力，预先准备多种动作条件下的后续片段，以单 latent 粒度的承诺决策配合共享历史树执行，在单张 H100 上实现 480p/16fps 的响应式世界模型流式生成，并显著降低输入到显示的延迟。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「细粒度 latent 承诺 + 预准备候选未来 + 共享历史树执行」可为 LVR 中并行候选推理状态的预计算、提交时机与动态计算成本权衡提供方法线索，但该承诺判据能否迁移到推理停止与视觉证据筛选仍需核查。
